---
title: "Single-Chiller COP Quick Check"
output:
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
    toc: false
mainfont: "Arial"
geometry: margin=2cm
params:
  input: "data/example_bms.csv"
  machine: "CH-01"
  rated_kw: 700
  low_cop: 3.5
  low_load: 0.30
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 3.3, dpi = 150)
if (!l10n_info()[["UTF-8"]]) {
  invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", "English_United States.utf8"))
}
source("core.R", encoding = "UTF-8")
library(ggplot2)
result <- load_cop_data(params$input, params$machine, params$rated_kw,
                        params$low_cop, params$low_load)
x <- result$data
x$status <- factor(ifelse(x$attention, "Low load + low COP",
                   ifelse(x$low_efficiency, "Low COP", "Normal")),
                   levels = c("Normal", "Low COP", "Low load + low COP"))
palette <- c("Normal" = "#2878a9", "Low COP" = "#e49c31",
             "Low load + low COP" = "#d94841")
```

**Chiller:** `r result$machine_id`  
**Period:** `r format(min(x$timestamp), "%Y-%m-%d")` to `r format(max(x$timestamp), "%Y-%m-%d")`  
**Rated cooling capacity:** `r result$rated_kw` kW

```{r summary}
knitr::kable(cop_summary(result), col.names = c("Metric", "Value"),
             align = c("l", "r"))
```

## COP vs Load Ratio

```{r load-scatter}
ggplot(x, aes(load_ratio * 100, cop, colour = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.65, size = 1.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = result$low_cop, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "#b94440") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = result$low_load * 100, linetype = "dotted",
             colour = "#b94440") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = palette, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Load ratio (%)", y = "Instantaneous COP", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial")
```

## COP vs Outdoor Temperature

```{r outdoor-scatter}
ggplot(x, aes(outdoor_temp_c, cop, colour = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.65, size = 1.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = result$low_cop, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "#b94440") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = palette, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Outdoor temperature (°C)", y = "Instantaneous COP", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial")
```

## Quick Assessment

`r if (any(x$attention)) "Low-load, low-COP points were found. Check operating duration, chiller staging strategy, and chilled-water flow." else if (any(x$low_efficiency)) "Low-COP points were found. Review operating settings against load ratio and outdoor temperature." else "No samples fell below the selected COP threshold."`

Cooling capacity is calculated as `r result$water_factor` × flow (m³/h) × chilled-water return-minus-supply temperature (°C); COP = cooling capacity / electric power. Screening thresholds are COP < `r result$low_cop` and load ratio < `r round(result$low_load * 100)`%. `r result$excluded` records were excluded because of missing values, invalid timestamps, non-operating conditions, or nonpositive temperature differences. This report is for quick screening; set thresholds using the chiller's performance data and site conditions.
